At 1:36:6s Beijing time on November 3, 2011, the "Tiangong-1" target spacecraft and the "Shenzhou-8" spacecraft successfully achieved their first rendezvous and docking. When the successful docking occurred, from the point located where did the solar altitude roughly decrease toward the surroundings?
